title: Worth it
text: Worth it. Didn't blend very well left chunks but overall for price good but easy to use and convenient

product_metadata.title: Portable Blender, G-TING Collapsible Personal Smoothies Blender Cordless, Single Serve Mini Blender 500ml USB Rechargeable Small Juice Mixer Portable Juicer Shakes, Smoothies, Home, Travel & Gym
features: ✅[Professional Blender]✅ This portable blender does not contain bisphenol A or any harmful chemicals, with food grade stainless steel blades and silicon cup. High quality material makes this personal blender suitable for making smoothies, juices, shakes, baby food and so on.

✅[Collapsible Design]✅ Collapsible design, this portable blender can be easily fit into your backpack. You can drink nutritious juice, shakes or smoothies anywhere you want, such as home, office, gym, travel, or any other outdoor activities.

✅[Upgrade Safety Design]✅ We improve our new portable blender. Unlike other blenders, our blender can not be turned on when you remove the blender cup from the base. No more safety concern when you are cleaning the blades. We also offer a cover for protecting the blades which can prevent children from accidentally touching and causing injuries.

✅[Strong & Powerful]✅ Equipped with powerful motor and sharp stainless steel four blades, the no load rotating speed can reach 16500 rpm±15%. By using such powerful personal blender, your favorite drinks like smoothies and shakes will be ready within 40 seconds.

✅[ USB Rechargeable]✅ This portable USB rechargeable blender equipped with 4000mAh rechargeable built-in battery which can be fully charged within 2-5 hours. The blender can produce 15-20 cups of juice when it is fully charged. You can charge the blender with different power source, like your phone charger, power bank, laptop and so on.
